template.comment.custom_webhook.enabled: # Generic custom webhook. Fill url, then set enabled to true.
template.comment.custom_webhook.payload: # JSON body template. {message} in leaf values becomes the notification text; variables such as {label} and {status} are also available.
template.comment.custom_webhook.url: # URL that receives the POST request.
template.comment.discord.enabled: # Discord webhook notifications. Fill webhook_url, then set enabled to true.
template.comment.discord.mention_user_id: # Optional mentions; empty by default to avoid accidental pings.
template.comment.discord.username: # Webhook display name and avatar; leave empty for the Discord defaults.
template.comment.force_schedule.interval:
# Forced backup schedule, ignoring player activity, disabled by default.
# interval_seconds > 0 uses a fixed interval; 0 with cron_expression = "0" disables it.
template.comment.language:
# Plugin language. The generated default uses the language passed by MCDR.
# Use an existing language file name, such as zh_cn, zh_tw, or en_us; unknown values fall back to en_us.
template.comment.maintenance_schedule.in:
# Repository maintenance schedule, daily at 03:00 by default.
# interval_seconds > 0 uses a fixed interval; 0 with cron_expression = "0" disables it.
template.comment.messages:
# Administrator notification message templates. You may freely customize the text.
# Available variables:
# {prefix} {label} {start_time} {end_time} {duration_seconds} {status} {message} {detail} {error}
# To output literal braces, use {{ or }}.
template.comment.minecraft.save_all_done: # Output keywords that mark save-all completion; adjust to match your server's log.
template.comment.minecraft.wait_after_sa: # Maximum time (seconds) to wait for save-all completion before backing up; finishes early once the completion hint is detected.
template.comment.minecraft.wait_for_save: # Whether to confirm save-all completion from server output; when disabled, always waits the full time above.
template.comment.notification: # Backup notification policy, applied to OneBot, Discord and the custom webhook.
template.comment.notification.notify_on_: # Notify when a backup is skipped.
template.comment.onebot.enabled: # OneBot v11 notifications. Fill admin_qqs, then set enabled to true.
template.comment.onebot.use_header_auth: # true puts the token in the Authorization header; false puts it in the URL parameter (commonly used by NapCat).
template.comment.restic.auto_init_local_: # Run restic init automatically when a local repository is missing; remote repositories are not initialized.
template.comment.restic.backup_command: # Backup command, executable prepended. Only worlds are backed up by default; consider the whole ./server directory or the MCDR root to protect files beyond the save data.
template.comment.restic.disk_check_enabl: # Check the free space of the disk hosting the local repository before each backup; refuse the backup when it falls below the threshold. Remote repositories are not checked.
template.comment.restic.disk_check_min_f: # Free-space threshold (percent, 0-100) below which backups are refused.
template.comment.restic.environment:
# Extra environment variables for restic; a null value removes an inherited variable.
# repository/password/password_file are exported as RESTIC_* variables automatically.
template.comment.restic.error_regexes: # Output matching these rules is treated as failure.
template.comment.restic.executable: # Every restic command runs with executable prepended; the default is the restic binary in the config folder.
template.comment.restic.maintenance_comm: # Repository maintenance commands, scheduled by maintenance_schedule, executable prepended.
template.comment.restic.password: # Repository password; password_file is used when empty. The sample password is for first-run testing only — change it for production.
template.comment.restic.password_file: # Password file, used only when password is empty.
template.comment.restic.progress_interva: # Progress echo interval for backup/restore --json, in seconds.
template.comment.restic.repository: # restic repository; a local repository under the MCDR root directory by default. Relative paths resolve against the MCDR root, not the server directory.
template.comment.restic.timeout_seconds: # Total timeout for restic command workflows, 0 means unlimited.
template.comment.restic.use_path_restic:
# Prefer the restic binary installed in the system PATH; probed and filled in automatically on first config generation.
# Falls back to the copy in the config folder (auto-downloaded when missing) if no system restic is detected.
template.comment.restic.working_director: # Working directory for the restic process; empty inherits the MCDR root directory (where config.yml lives).
template.comment.restore.pre_restore_bac: # Tag applied to the safety snapshot created before restoring.
template.comment.restore.start_timeout_s: # Timeouts for stopping/starting Minecraft during the restore workflow (seconds).
template.comment.schedule.cron_expressio: # 6-field cron: second minute hour day month weekday. Default: every 3 hours.
template.comment.schedule.interval_secon: # interval_seconds > 0 uses a fixed interval; 0 uses the 6-field cron below.
template.comment.schedule.online_check_c: # Minecraft command used to query online players, executed via RCON; without RCON only join/left events are used.
template.comment.schedule.require_player: # Whether to back up only in periods with player activity: combines join/left events with the online count at trigger time; skips quiet periods.
template.comment.snapshot_cache.database: # Cache database file name, under the plugin config directory
template.comment.snapshot_cache.enabled: # Snapshot list cache for the status command.
template.comment.snapshot_cache.query_ti: # Timeout for restic snapshots when refreshing the cache (seconds)
template.comment.update_check.api_url: # GitHub latest release API. When the network is slow or blocked, proxy_prefixes are tried in order.
template.comment.update_check.enabled: # Version update checks. When enabled, the plugin checks once on load and once every day at 00:00.
template.header:
# MCDR2Restic configuration
# state.yml is the runtime state file. Do not modify it.
template.message.backup_skip_no_player:
{prefix} Backup skipped
No players joined or left during this period, and nobody was online at the final check
template.message.schedule_config_error:
{prefix} Schedule configuration error
Failed to calculate the next backup time: {error}
template.snippet.config_version_marker_c: # Config file version marker. Keep it at the end for future migrations.
template.snippet.default_backup_comment:
__MCDR2RESTIC_PLATFORM_POSIX__
  # Newly generated configs include only ./server/world by default. If all three world directories exist when the file is generated, world_nether and world_the_end are added automatically.
__MCDR2RESTIC_PLATFORM_WINDOWS__
  # Newly generated configs include only .\server\world by default. If all three world directories exist when the file is generated, world_nether and world_the_end are added automatically.
template.snippet.minecraft_save_all_comm:
__MCDR2RESTIC_PLATFORM_POSIX__
  # Linux Java Edition example. If your server does not support save-all flush, use save-all instead.
__MCDR2RESTIC_PLATFORM_WINDOWS__
  # Windows Java Edition example. If your server does not support save-all flush, use save-all instead.
template.snippet.session_lock_exclude_co: # On Windows, Minecraft locks session.lock; exclude it by default to avoid restic exit code 3.
